title: Security: heap-buffer-overflow in blink::ScriptFunction::~ScriptFunction()
description_snippet:
**VULNERABILITY DETAILS**   
The following testcase crashes the latest ASAN build of content_shell. It requires the flag --js-flags=--expose-gc and might need a few attempts in which it is crashing on a null-ptr SEGV.  
  
**VERSION**   
Chrome Version: asan-linux-release-561018
